title: The Spellforge Ends Here
description: A surreal fantasy scene features a massive glowing purple tree with intricate spiral patterns and roots extending into reflective water. A robed wizard stands on a stone platform holding a glowing lantern, while a black dragon flies through a swirling vortex sky filled with floating geometric shapes and dripping elements.
prompt: A mystical fantasy landscape with a giant ancient tree glowing with purple spiral patterns and magical symbols, its roots reaching into a reflective pool of water. A dark robed wizard stands on a stone outcrop holding a glowing lantern, a black dragon soars through a swirling purple and blue vortex sky with floating geometric shapes and dripping ink elements. Floating lanterns and ethereal faces appear in the water, with a wooden sign reading 'The Spellforge Ends Here' in the foreground, vibrant colors with magical atmosphere.
